title: Past continuous: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: At midnight, my neighbours ___ (to play) loud music.
items.explanationEs: Algo en curso a una hora del pasado. My neighbours es plural: were playing.

items.text: I ___ (to drive) home when I saw the accident.
items.explanationEs: La acción larga, en pasado continuo (was driving); la corta (saw), en pasado simple.

items.text: We ___ (not / listen) when the teacher explained it.
items.explanationEs: Negativa con we: weren't + verbo con -ing.

items.source: He was working in the garden.
answers: Was he working in the garden?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: was pasa delante del sujeto, como en el pasado de to be.

items.source: They were laughing at the joke.
answers: They weren't laughing at the joke.
items.explanationEs: Negativa: were + not (weren't) y el verbo con -ing.

items.sentence: Sara were reading when I arrived.
items.explanationEs: Sara es una persona (she): was, no were.
